hooks.prompt:
RESPOND WITH ONLY A JSON OBJECT. No other text, no explanation, no markdown. Format: {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "brief description"}

Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if this session involved grading a codebase (running dimension reviewers, computing scores, generating grade reports). If NO grading work was performed in this session, respond {"ok": true} immediately — this hook only applies to grading sessions. If grading WAS performed, verify: 1) All 8 grading dimensions have been scored or explicitly marked N/A with written justification — dimensions are: component quality, state management, styling/CSS, accessibility, performance, TypeScript usage, testing quality, UX patterns, 2) A weighted composite aggregate score has been computed from the dimension scores, 3) A final grading report has been generated with executive summary, dimension scorecards, findings with evidence, and fix suggestions. Respond {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: list what is incomplete or absent"}.
